title: The tokenizer has a bug. Find it.
concept: The scoring function was flawless and the results were wrong, because the analyzer quietly re-partitioned the term space.
skill: You can read a tokenizer's character class and say which identifiers it will shred before it shreds them.
deeper: wiki/Common-Errors.md -- 'A query returns results and they are the wrong results, with no error' is this bug's entry
